# Marin Mersenne

*1588 – 1648 · French*

A Minim friar settled in Paris, he made his cell the hub of a learned correspondence linking [Descartes](../philosophers/descartes.md), [Hobbes](../philosophers/hobbes.md), Gassendi and Galileo. He gathered the objections to the *Meditations* and worked himself on acoustics and music.
